entities.name: Lukáš Konečný
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lukáš Konečný is a Czech former professional boxer. He held the WBO interim, European and European Union light-middleweight titles, and challenged for a middleweight world title in his final fight. Konečný is widely considered to be the most successful boxer from the Czech Republic.
